name: PhD in Neuroscience and Behavior
detailsNote: Official information available; the December 1 deadline is published without a year and is not confirmed for Fall 2027. GRE, how students are admitted (program or lab) and stipend amounts are not stated on the pages checked.
summary: PhD program in neuroscience and behavior at UMass Amherst. Promising candidates are invited to a recruiting weekend; strong international applicants are interviewed by phone or in person.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published application deadline
publishedDeadlines.dateText: December 1 of each calendar year for admission in September of the following year
publishedDeadlines.note: Published without a year. Not confirmed for Fall 2027; confirm with the program. Reference letters must arrive no later than December 8.

timeline.interviews: Promising candidates are invited to the annual "recruiting weekend". Foreign applicants who have strong credentials must also be interviewed, by telephone and/or in person.

english.note: Minimums are the Graduate School's for international applicants. The program page says TOEFL scores should be sent to the Graduate Admissions Office; check the Graduate School page for who is exempt.

applicationFee.note: The program page lists $85.00 for Massachusetts residents, other US citizens and permanent residents, and international applicants. Waivers are offered to eligible domestic students from underrepresented groups.

documents: Official transcripts of coursework at other institutions
requirements.note: Most successful applicants have a cumulative undergraduate GPA of 3.25 or better. Reference letters must be submitted by December 8.
